_why: Skill-candidates row `the evidence gate counts tool CALLS, not their TARGETS` (LANDED 2026-10-05): the EVIDENCE/CODEXEVIDENCE lines and the audit-cycle Effort block carry paths=/code=/other=/unmeasured= beside tools= when a project root is given (absent, never zero, without one); agy run_command lines and codex exec blocks are shell-split and only EXISTING paths count; codex MCP calls (no arguments printed) are unmeasured; the split is code (under root, not docs/) vs other; the figures never change a verdict; the audit-cycle driver threads the root, records the figures in the effort sidecar, and COPIES the pass log to <root>/.h-mad/pass-logs/<collected>.log with its sha256, a copy failure being advisory. Each row breaks one of those properties.

mutations.name: command-line-is-one-path
mutations._mechanism: A shell command line is tried as ONE path instead of being split into words, so every run_command reads as zero targets -- agy's only read channel in the calibration corpus goes blind.

mutations.name: agy-cwd-ignored
mutations._mechanism: init.cwd is dropped, so relative tokens resolve against the root instead of where the leg actually ran.

mutations.name: agy-reads-outcomes-not-starts
mutations._mechanism: Only DONE steps are read, so a call whose start carried parameters but whose outcome never arrived vanishes instead of being counted.

mutations.name: agy-hidden-call-is-zero
mutations._mechanism: An agy call with no visible parameters is silently a zero-target call instead of unmeasured.

mutations.name: grok-hidden-call-is-zero
mutations._mechanism: A grok tool_call without rawInput is silently a zero-target call instead of unmeasured.

mutations.name: codex-mcp-is-zero
mutations._mechanism: Calibration finding 3: codex MCP calls print no arguments. Counting them as nothing reports a leg that ran 22 ctx_execute calls as having touched nothing.

mutations.name: codex-orphan-exec-dropped
mutations._mechanism: An exec block with no parseable command is dropped instead of counted unmeasured.

mutations.name: codex-exec-cwd-ignored
mutations._mechanism: The exec block's own ` in <cwd>` is ignored, so its relative tokens resolve against the header workdir.
mutations.find: candidates.extend((word, tail) for word in words)  # M:TGT-EXECCWD
mutations.replace: candidates.extend((word, root) for word in words)  # M:TGT-EXECCWD

mutations.name: codex-shell-wrapper-not-unwrapped
mutations._mechanism: `/bin/zsh -lc '<cmd>'` is not unwrapped, so the real command is one unsplit word and its targets are lost.

mutations.name: missing-root-measured
mutations._mechanism: A root that is not a directory is measured anyway, so every target lands in `other` and a not-measured reads as a measurement.
mutations.find: if root is None or not Path(root).is_dir():  # M:TGT-NOROOT

mutations.name: relative-token-uses-process-cwd
mutations._mechanism: Relative tokens resolve against the scanner's own working directory instead of the leg's.

mutations.name: nonexistent-tokens-counted
mutations._mechanism: Every word of every command is a target: grep patterns and flags inflate the count.

mutations.name: root-itself-counted
mutations._mechanism: `ls .` counts the project root as a code target.

mutations.name: spellings-not-normalised
mutations._mechanism: Two spellings of one file (`src/../src/a.py`) count as two distinct targets.
mutations.find: path = path.resolve()  # M:TGT-DEDUP: one spelling per target
mutations.replace: path = path.absolute()  # M:TGT-DEDUP: one spelling per target

mutations.name: docs-counted-as-code
mutations._mechanism: Files under the root's docs/ tree are counted as code, erasing the split.

mutations.name: not-measured-prints-zeros
mutations._mechanism: With no root the line prints `paths=0 ...`: a not-measured rendered as a measured zero.
mutations.replace: return " paths=0 code=0 other=0 unmeasured=0"  # M:TGT-FMTABSENT

mutations.name: evidence-line-drops-targets
mutations._mechanism: The agy EVIDENCE line does not carry the figures.

mutations.name: code-zero-becomes-a-gate
mutations._mechanism: The advisory counter creeps into the verdict: a pass that opened no code file is judged NONE.
mutations.replace: verdict = "PASS" if counts["ok"] >= 1 and counts.get("targets", {}).get("code", 1) else "NONE"

mutations.name: codex-line-drops-targets
mutations._mechanism: The CODEXEVIDENCE line does not carry the figures.

mutations.name: grok-line-drops-targets
mutations._mechanism: The grok EVIDENCE line does not carry the figures.

mutations.name: effort-codex-keeps-agy-zeros
mutations._mechanism: A codex log's Effort targets are the agy instrument's false zeros instead of the codex instrument's figures.

mutations.name: effort-grok-drops-targets
mutations._mechanism: A grok pass's Effort carries no targets though they were measured.

mutations.name: unparseable-log-keeps-a-zero
mutations._mechanism: A stray --log that is no transcript keeps the agy instrument's zero targets: a measurement of a file the instrument cannot read.

mutations.name: effort-render-drops-targets
mutations._mechanism: The Effort block does not show the figures beside tools=.

mutations.name: effort-render-codex-drops-targets
mutations._mechanism: A codex pass's Effort line hides its measured exec targets and unmeasured MCP calls.
mutations.find: + (" targets:" + format_targets(effort) if "targets" in effort else ""))

mutations.name: driver-measures-without-root
mutations._mechanism: The driver never threads the project root, so no pass ever carries targets.

mutations.name: driver-never-retains
mutations._mechanism: The driver never copies the pass log: the gate's verdict stays unauditable after /tmp is gone.

mutations.name: sidecar-drops-retention
mutations._mechanism: The sidecar does not record where the log was retained or its hash.

mutations.name: retention-moves-the-log
mutations._mechanism: Retention MOVES the log, so the /tmp consumers that still read the original lose it.

mutations.name: sha-is-not-of-the-copy
mutations._mechanism: The recorded sha256 does not match the retained bytes, so the copy cannot be verified.

mutations.name: retention-failure-loses-the-verdict
mutations._mechanism: A retention OSError escapes the loop, whose only handler is OperationalError, and the cycle loses a completed pass's verdict over a log copy.

mutations.name: codex-hook-lines-glued-to-cwd
mutations._mechanism: Review M1: interleaved `hook:` lines run on into the cwd, every relative token resolves under a directory that does not exist, and a visible read counts as a silent zero.

mutations.name: codex-multiline-cwd-accepted
mutations._mechanism: Review M1, general case: any foreign line after ` in <cwd>` becomes part of the cwd and the block is a silent zero instead of unmeasured.
mutations.find: if not (sep and tail.startswith("/") and "\n" not in tail):  # M:TGT-EXECPARSE

mutations.name: codex-back-to-back-exec-unmeasured
mutations._mechanism: Review S5: the first of two back-to-back exec headers is counted unmeasured although its command is fully visible.
mutations.replace: head, sep, tail = ("\n".join(body) if j < len(lines) and lines[j] != "exec" else "").rpartition(" in ")

mutations.name: root-ancestors-counted
mutations._mechanism: Review S3: `ls .. /` counts filesystem roots as targets, so paths= rises on a pass that read nothing.

mutations.name: unbalanced-quote-kept-on-token
mutations._mechanism: Review N2: the whitespace fallback keeps the quote character, so `cat 'src/a.py` measures nothing.
mutations.find: return [word.strip("'\"") for word in text.split()]  # M:TGT-QUOTEFALLBACK

mutations.name: relative-agy-cwd-trusted
mutations._mechanism: Review N3: a relative or empty init.cwd resolves against the scanner's own cwd.

mutations.name: bad-root-silent
mutations._mechanism: Review N4: a typo'd --project-root is indistinguishable from none, because the note never reaches stderr.

mutations.name: pass-logs-not-self-ignored
mutations._mechanism: Review S2: the retention dir carries no ignore file, so in a project that does not ignore it (HemaSuite) `git add .h-mad` commits full transcripts.

mutations.name: retention-writes-in-place
mutations._mechanism: Review S6: the copy is written over the destination directly, so a part-way failure tears it and destroys the earlier good copy.

mutations.name: retention-staging-left-behind
mutations._mechanism: Review S6: a failed copy leaves its staging file in pass-logs.

mutations.name: log-retained-relative
mutations._mechanism: Review N6: with a relative --project-root the sidecar records a relative path that points nowhere from another cwd.

mutations.name: codex-effort-label-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Review N5: measured codex targets print straight after `not measured (...)`, contradicting it.
mutations.find: + (" targets:" + format_targets(effort) if "targets" in effort else ""))
